column_descriptions.UT: External Web of Science record identifier (source key); format WOS:<15 digits>.
column_descriptions.biome: Global Ecosystem Typology biome or biomes of study focus (L4 coding).
column_descriptions.doi: Digital Object Identifier, as retrieved from Web of Science.
column_descriptions.driver: IPBES direct driver category or categories assigned to the record (L1 coding).
column_descriptions.id: Stable integer primary key: the integer value of the 15-digit WOS UT suffix.
column_descriptions.locale_coordinates: [latitude, longitude] pairs (WGS84, EPSG:4326) for the named locales, where resolvable.
column_descriptions.locales: Free-text names of sub-national locations mentioned in the title or abstract, such as parks, reserves, cities, or mountain ranges.
column_descriptions.plastics_mention: True if the title or abstract mentions plastics or marine-debris terminology (see DEFAULT_PLASTICS_PATTERN).
column_descriptions.pred_comparison_types: Type or types of comparison identified for the record, populated when pred_has_comparison is true.
column_descriptions.pred_countries: Countries of study focus (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes), as originally coded (L3).
column_descriptions.pred_countries_audit: Reviewed country label(s); same review-flag convention as pred_regions_audit.
column_descriptions.pred_has_comparison: True if the record explicitly states or strongly implies a comparator (e.g. pre/post, control vs. exposed, reference sites); otherwise false.
column_descriptions.pred_methods_analysis: Analysis method(s) reported in the title or abstract, where applicable.
column_descriptions.pred_methods_data_collection: Data collection method(s) reported in the title or abstract, where applicable.
column_descriptions.pred_regions: IPBES region or regions of study focus, as originally coded (L3).
column_descriptions.pred_regions_audit: Reviewed region label(s): equals pred_regions except review-flagged records, which become ['Unclear - Review needed'] per the IPBES hierarchy audit.
column_descriptions.pred_study_design: Study design category: Observational, Experimental, Modelling, Review, or Unclear.
column_descriptions.pred_subregions: IPBES sub-region or sub-regions of study focus, as originally coded (L3).
column_descriptions.pred_subregions_audit: Reviewed sub-region label(s); same review-flag convention as pred_regions_audit.
column_descriptions.pred_threat_l0: Broadest IUCN Threats Classification level assigned to the record (L2 coding).
column_descriptions.publication_year: Year of publication, as retrieved from Web of Science.
column_descriptions.realm: Global Ecosystem Typology realm or realms of study focus (L4 coding).
column_descriptions.s1_bio: Q1 biodiversity change type(s): genetic, species, community, and/or ecosystem change.
column_descriptions.s1_r: Q1 screening result: biodiversity change reported? 1 = Yes, -1 = Unclear, 0 = No.
column_descriptions.s2_dir: Q2 direction of biodiversity change: negative, positive, mixed, or unclear (eligible records exclude 'none').
column_descriptions.s2_r: Q2 screening result: direction of change identifiable? 1 = Yes, -1 = Unclear, 0 = No.
column_descriptions.s3_drivers: Q3 driver or threat name(s) identified during screening; supports eligibility only, not the final L1/L2 coding (see driver, pred_threat_l0).
column_descriptions.s3_r: Q3 screening result: direct anthropogenic driver mentioned or plausibly implied? 1 = Yes, -1 = Unclear, 0 = No.
column_descriptions.s4_link: Q4 linkage type(s) describing how the identified driver is linked to the reported biodiversity change.
column_descriptions.s4_r: Q4 screening result: driver-biodiversity linkage reported or plausibly implied? 1 = Yes, -1 = Unclear, 0 = No.
column_descriptions.taxa_class_labels: Class(es) resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (L6).
column_descriptions.taxa_family_labels: Family/families resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy lineage of matched taxa; a derived rank, not directly named by the LLM coder (unlike the other taxa_*_labels ranks).
column_descriptions.taxa_genus_labels: Genus/genera resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (L6).
column_descriptions.taxa_kingdom_labels: Kingdom(s) resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy from the article's LLM-extracted taxa mentions (L6).
column_descriptions.taxa_order_labels: Order(s) resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (L6).
column_descriptions.taxa_phylum_labels: Phylum/phyla resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (L6).
column_descriptions.taxa_record_status: Per-publication GBIF-resolution status of the LLM-extracted taxa mentions: resolved, partly_resolved, or unresolved.
column_descriptions.taxa_species_labels: Species resolved through the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (L6).
column_descriptions.text_available: True if usable title/abstract text was available for the plastics/marine-debris text-mention check.

grain: one row per eligible screening publication (id; UT source key)
id_derivation: integer value of the 15-digit WOS UT suffix
scope: all screening-eligible publications; direction, year, threat, realm, geography, study, and taxa filters are not applied

withheld_columns.title: Article title from the Web of Science Core Collection; not redistributed (retrieve by UT).
